entry.name: adc~
entry.description: The adc~ ("analog-to-digital converter") object outputs one or more signals (one per outlet) with audio from hardware input devices.

arguments.name: inputs
arguments.description: Ifhas one numeric argument, it determines the number of outlets that produce signals from audio input hardware starting with logical input channel 1. Ifhas more than one argument, it is taken as a list of logical input channels assigned to its outlets. If no arguments are supplied,will have two outlets, initially set to logical input channels 1 and 2.If a symbol is provided as the first argument to, its output will come from a named inport port in the Max mixer. Ifinstances in a patcher hierarchy share the same name they will use the same mixer input port.

messages.name: set
messages.digest: Set the logical input channel for a signal outlet
messages.description: The word, followed by two numbers, sets the logical input channel for one of the object's signal outlets. The first number specifies the outlet number, whereis the leftmost outlet. The second number specifies the logical input channel (from 1 to 1024). If the second number is, the outlet sends out the zero signal.
